instruction: Review all changes from benchmark-base through the final on-disk worktree, including committed, staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted files. Do not fix, stage, or commit anything. archive.allowed(member) decides whether a POSIX archive member stays within an extraction root. Reject absolute paths, any backslash, and any .. traversal that moves above root at any point; normalize . and repeated slashes. A valid internal a/../b is allowed. The renamed helper must enforce the same behavior. Attribute the defect to the new helper implementation. Attribute each defect to the responsible function or file rather than a forwarding caller. Report no findings when every change satisfies the stated contract.
